Crash detection arrives. Flytower follows systemd's journal, so it notices a crash the moment it happens and records the cause, the crash report and the last 50 lines of the log. The Console tab shows a crash banner, **Logs → Crashes** keeps 30 days of history, and new alerts cover crashes, crash loops and servers that stop responding.

After three crashes in ten minutes a server is left stopped instead of restarting forever, and **Start** or **Restart** clears it. A server that misses five console answers in a row is marked **Not responding**, and can be restarted automatically under **Settings → Crashes**. Stops and restarts from Flytower, or a `stop` typed in the console, never count as crashes.

Flytower is now free software under the GNU AGPL v3.0.

Testing notes are in section 2 of [testing-1.1.0.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.1.0-beta.4/docs/testing-1.1.0.md).
